why.en: Black is a colour. A colour word has no -s: My cat is black.
why.uz: Black rangni bildiradi. Rang soʻziga -s qoʻshilmaydi: My cat is black.
why.ru: Black — это цвет. К слову-цвету не добавляют -s: My cat is black.

why.en: After two comes three (3). Tree is a plant, and thirty is 30.

why.en: We say can + verb: My friend can dance. Can never takes -s.
why.uz: Can + feʼl deymiz: My friend can dance. Can ga hech qachon -s qoʻshilmaydi.
why.ru: Говорим can + глагол: My friend can dance. К can никогда не добавляют -s.

why.en: After can the verb has no -s, no -ing and no to: She can sing.
why.uz: Can dan keyin feʼlga -s, -ing yoki to qoʻshilmaydi: She can sing.
why.ru: После can глагол стоит без -s, без -ing и без to: She can sing.

stem.en: A: ___ you ride a bike? B: Yes, I can.

why.en: The answer is Yes, I can, so the question starts with Can.
why.uz: Javob Yes, I can, demak savol Can bilan boshlanadi.
why.ru: Ответ — Yes, I can, значит вопрос начинается с Can.

stem.en: I can run, but I ___ swim.

why.en: But shows the other side: I can run, but I can't swim. Can't means cannot.
why.uz: But qarama-qarshi fikrni bildiradi: I can run, but I can't swim. Can't — cannot degani.
why.ru: But показывает противоположное: I can run, but I can't swim. Can't — это cannot.

why.uz: Can bilan berilgan savolga can bilan qisqa javob beriladi: No, he can't.
why.ru: На вопрос с can отвечают коротко с can: No, he can't.

why.ru: После can глагол стоит в простой форме, без -s и без -ed: We can play chess.
